radiology_report: Prostate volume: 34.49 cc. PSA density: 0.151 ng/mL/cc. PI-RADS: 4. AI model-predicted probability of clinically significant prostate cancer (0–1): 0.5618297.
pathology_report: The patient underwent 2 biopsy sessions. At the first session, Gleason 3+4 with tertiary pattern 4 (ISUP grade group 2, AI model-predicted ISUP 3) was identified in the left peripheral zone (mid); cribriform pattern was present, with no intraductal carcinoma. In the same month, at the second session, Gleason 3+3 (ISUP grade group 1, AI model-predicted ISUP 3) was identified in the left peripheral zone; cribriform pattern was present. The reported histological growth pattern was: Adenocarcinoma; Cribriform.
surgical_pathology_report: The robot-assisted radical prostatectomy specimen showed Gleason 3+4 (ISUP grade group 2), pathological stage pT2c. There was no extraprostatic extension; surgical margins were negative; the seminal vesicles were not invaded; lymphovascular invasion was absent; no lymph nodes were removed.
